semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Three derived AE causal results, not three printed source theorems. The policy-version result allows any measure and measurable seed space, needs relative AE strong measurability and AE unit feasibility, and makes one classically chosen, law-relative measurable policy family globally unit-valued. Equality to the original process holds on a common full-measure event; exceptional null samples may differ. The deterministic-time independence theorem needs probability, measurable jointly independent targets and a measurable seed independent of the whole infinite process, but no bounds, common law or moments. The IID excess result additionally needs common target laws and AE unit bounds; ambient L2 regularity, current independence and attained fixed-comparator minimum are derived. The infimum is outside expectation, and the mean is analysis-only. The same process works for every natural horizon including zero, without any rate or asymptotic-success claim. General completed-information and universal kernel representation, remaining chapter/book obligations and eight historical hash-use obligations remain open.
